name: kaafil-js-examples
description: Runnable reference examples for the kaafil-js SDK: a Node server walkthrough and a browser manager-session demo.

scripts.play: bash -c "trap 'kill 0' EXIT; pnpm run backend & pnpm run dev & wait"

comment:play: `play` runs backend/server.ts and vite browser concurrently in one process group with a trap so Ctrl-C stops both — a tiny bash one-liner, deliberately not a new npm-run-all-style dependency. Two terminals (`pnpm run backend` in one, `pnpm run dev` in the other) works exactly as well and is the more debuggable option — see backend/README.md.
comment:kaafil-js: kaafil-js is not published to npm yet, so this resolves the SDK from a sibling checkout. On publish day this becomes a version range ("^0.1.0") and nothing else in the repo changes.
comment:pnpm: The esbuild build-script allowlist lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which is where this pnpm reads it from.
